sentences.text: Taal Volcano in the Philippines began to erupt on January 12, 2020, with a phreatomagmatic eruption from its main crater.
The eruption sent ashes over Calabarzon, Metro Manila, and parts of Central Luzon.
The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology monitored the situation.
The eruptions caused suspension of school classes, work schedules, and flights in the area.
Taal Volcano is a large caldera filled by Taal Lake.
The volcano is located in the province of Batangas about 50 kilometers south of Manila.
